fields.description: Mangrove is a two-building apartment collection at Creek Beach, arranged around landscaped shared spaces beside a park. The launch mix contains 135 one, two and three bedroom homes. Buildings 1 and 2 have their own layouts and size ranges, with balconies linking the apartments to the surrounding courtyard, park and neighbourhood.

overview: Mangrove’s smaller buildings frame a central plaza and landscaped courtyard. Its brochure describes restrained interiors, private balconies and terraces, and shared spaces intended for everyday use rather than occasional visits. A gym, outdoor cinema and separate toddler play space supplement the pool and garden areas. The surrounding Creek Beach neighbourhood provides additional shops, restaurants and walking destinations; access and operating arrangements should be checked separately.
research.locationNote: The development sits beside a park in Creek Beach, near Vida Creek Beach and within the wider Dubai Creek Harbour waterfront district. Creek Marina, Harbour Promenade and Central Park are named nearby destinations. Views depend on building and orientation; brochure travel times are indicative rather than guaranteed.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s available-unit section lists AED 4,109,888, while its headline retains AED 1.48m. The May 2024 launch fact sheet listed one, two and three bedrooms from AED 1.48m, 2.31m and 3.49m respectively. These refer to different dates and unit selections; obtain a current written quotation.
research.paymentNote: The May 2024 launch plan required 80% before completion and 20% at estimated completion. Every scheduled date has now passed. It is retained as historical project information, not a payment offer for a new purchase; confirm the selected unit’s present sale and settlement terms.
research.handoverNote: July 2026 is the original estimated completion month, not a future handover promise. The date has passed. Current broker descriptions vary between completed and status-on-request, and the reviewed official project page does not confirm possession. Request completion and handover documentation for the specific building and unit.

facts.label: Launch mix
facts.value: 63 one-bedroom, 52 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom apartments total 135 homes. This is the launch collection, not current available inventory.

facts.label: Compact apartment example
facts.value: Building 2 level 1 unit 101 totals 614.62 sq ft, comprising 548.53 sq ft of apartment area and a 66.09 sq ft balcony. Its plan includes a separate laundry space and an open kitchen/dining arrangement.

facts.label: Larger family layout
facts.value: Building 2 levels 2–8 unit 10 totals 1,700.81 sq ft, with 1,566.26 sq ft inside and a 134.55 sq ft balcony. The drawing includes three bedrooms, a maid’s room, laundry and a separate powder room.

facts.label: Building-specific documents
facts.value: The primary floor-plan download covers Building 1 only. Building 2 has its own linked source and different measurements. Published areas include balconies; approved unit plans and contractual measurements should be checked before purchase.
